title: Senior Citizen Bus Pass & Hospital Concession Guide
title_te: వృద్ధులకు బస్ పాస్ & ఆసుపత్రి రాయితీ గైడ్
problem: My grandfather pays full ticket fare on RTC buses because he does not know that senior citizens get discounts with an official age proof card.
idea: A large-font guide for Thatha. A calculator shows how much he could save with a senior citizen concession, and a checklist shows what to carry. The discount amount is editable because rules can change.

widgets.heading: 🧮 How Much Can Thatha Save?
widgets.intro: Enter the discount the RTC depot tells you. The 25% below is only a sample – confirm the current rule at the bus depot.

inputs.label: Senior citizen discount (%) – confirm at depot

widgets.formula: if ([fare, trips, disc].some(function(x){return typeof x !== 'number' || x < 0;}) || disc > 100) return null; var save = fare * trips * disc / 100; return {pay: Math.round(fare * (1 - disc / 100)), month: Math.round(save), year: Math.round(save * 12), level: 'good'};

items.text: Age proof / ID card (Aadhaar or senior citizen card)
items.te: వయస్సు ధృవపత్రం / గుర్తింపు కార్డు (ఆధార్ లేదా సీనియర్ సిటిజన్ కార్డు)

items.text: Copy of ID in his pocket
Health card / Aarogyasri card (if he has one)
Family phone number written on paper

bands.text: Thatha is ready to travel and save!
Add the missing items before he leaves.
Pack the ID card first – it's the most important.

items.title: Ask the conductor
items.text: Show the age proof and ask if a senior citizen concession applies on this bus.
items.te: వయస్సు ధృవపత్రం చూపించి రాయితీ ఉందా అని కండక్టర్‌ని అడగండి.

items.title: Hospital help desk
items.text: In government hospitals, ask the help desk about a separate line for elders.
items.te: ప్రభుత్వ ఆసుపత్రిలో వృద్ధుల కోసం వేరే క్యూ ఉందా అని అడగండి.

how: Ask Gemini about general senior citizen benefits for bus travel and hospitals in Telangana.
Visit the nearest RTC bus depot and a government hospital help desk to confirm the real rules.
Open Canva and choose a small booklet (A5) template.
Use very large Telugu letters, one tip per page, with pictures.
Add the savings example and the 'what to carry' list.
Print copies and give them to elders at the village temple or Panchayat meeting.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. In very simple Telugu with large-font style short lines, list general benefits senior citizens (60+) in Telangana can ask about for bus travel and government hospitals. Do not give exact discount amounts. Tell them to confirm at the RTC depot and hospital help desk.
